description:
Join d-Matrix and help build the future of AI inference. We’ve pioneered a memory-centric architecture that brings compute directly into memory, making AI faster, more energy efficient, and accessible on a global scale. From chips and software to rack-scale systems, our team is tackling some of AI infrastructure’s hardest challenges — and shipping breakthrough technology today. If you want to create what comes next and help make infinite inference possible, we’d love to hear from you.

Our culture is built on respect, collaboration, and direct communication. We value humility, we believe our different perspectives lead to better solutions, and we’re looking for people who are driven by execution and energized by hard problems.

Role Overview

As a Senior Event Marketing & Strategy Manager, you’ll own the strategy and day-to-day execution of the d-Matrix event portfolio, from major AI infrastructure conferences and trade shows to partner events, executive roundtables, and technical meetups. You’ll decide where events can advance product and sales priorities, then work with Sales, Product, and Engineering to turn those opportunities into live demos, technical talks, and customer meetings. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role.

What you will do

  • Own the annual event strategy and calendar. Recommend where to invest and how to participate based on audience fit, priority accounts, product milestones, cost, and past performance.

  • Own the end-to-end event experience, from booth strategy, creative development, and branding through onsite execution. Lead day-to-day delivery for major events, including production, staffing, shipping, and onsite operations.

  • Manage the event portfolio budget, forecast spend and negotiate sponsorships and vendor agreements. Select and manage exhibit houses, production agencies, contractors, and other external vendors to deliver on time, on brand, and on budget.

  • Independently manage multiple complex, concurrent events with minimal oversight, balancing competing priorities, and keeping cross-functional teams aligned on timelines and deliverables.

  • Lead planning with Product and Engineering for booth experiences, live demos, and technical sessions. Set priorities and coordinate rehearsals to ensure teams are ready for each event.

  • Build the event speaking plan. Identify priority stages, manage calls for speakers and submission deadlines, and coordinate abstracts, presentation reviews, and speaker preparation.

  • Plan and run executive programs around key events, including executive meetings, customer dinners, investor engagements, and private briefings. Partner with executives and Sales to set agendas, secure attendees, and prepare briefing materials.

  • Set goals with Sales for priority-account outreach and customer meetings.

  • Own integrated promotional plans for each event across email, social media, and digital campaigns in partnership with Marketing. Manage lead capture, routing, and post-event follow-up in HubSpot.

  • Set KPIs for each event and own post-event analysis. Report on customer meetings, target-account engagement, qualified leads, influenced pipeline, and spend, then use the results to guide future investment.

What you will bring (minimum qualifications)

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B event marketing, field marketing, or event management, including end-to-end ownership of a multi-event portfolio and hands-on execution of major industry conferences, sponsorships, or customer events.

  • Experience managing event budgets, negotiating sponsorships and vendor agreements, and managing exhibit houses, production agencies, contractors, and external vendors.

  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple complex, concurrent events and competing priorities with minimal oversight.

  • Track record of recommending event investments using business goals, audience fit, and past performance.

  • Experience leading cross-functional event planning with Sales, technical teams, executives, and external partners.

  • Experience building integrated event promotion across email, social media, and digital channels, including post-event follow-up.

  • Experience using a CRM for lead capture, routing, and reporting on event KPIs, pipeline influence, and target-account engagement.

  • Ability to travel for events and support occasional evening or weekend programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in AI infrastructure, semiconductors, data centers, cloud, or enterprise technology.

  • Experience coordinating live technical demos, managing speaking submissions, or producing events with ecosystem partners.

  • Experience planning executive programs such as customer dinners, private briefings, or investor engagements.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot.

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

d-Matrix is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication, and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day.

d-Matrix does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individuals interested in opportunities with d-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of all applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
